verdict.rationale: NotebookLM is primarily a chat/RAG tool that answers questions with citations over a fixed set of uploaded sources (docs-2, docs-28, docs-29), not an agentic multi-step investigator. There is a hint of autonomous source-gathering via 'discover new sources' (docs-1) and a probe reference to 'Deep Research / Fast Research modes that gather web sources into the notebook' (notebooklm-probe-rt-1), suggesting some capability to autonomously expand a corpus, but no documentation describes iterative reasoning, follow-up querying, or a multi-step investigation loop beyond single-pass summarization/formats (docs-3, docs-27). A community comment explicitly notes the product could not 'search for docs and then incorporate them into your research' (notebooklm-comm-4), tempering confidence in how robust the newer research modes are. Missing for 10: detailed documentation or hands-on evidence of iterative, multi-step autonomous investigation (e.g., follow-up questions, evolving hypotheses, synthesis across multiple search rounds) rather than one-shot source discovery plus static Q&A.
